purpose: Normal integrated source build of the user-approved wider fan and twelve unchanged component types, with explicit mesh-reuse provenance.

approved_fan_geometry.fresh_compilation_source_changes: Only two taper_start_distance values from 8 to 48 m and two taper_end_distance values from 48 to 72 m; all other geometry inputs unchanged.

guarded_saved_model_reuse.scope: Reuse only verified model meshes from the accepted current 12-type build and the freshly compiled, user-approved standalone fan-width build. The original build_piece and every ordinary build verifier remain active.

generation_scope: The current original build_piece generated PATHs, shadows, exemplars, combined previews, effects, rules, menus, and archives for all thirteen types. Only the tile model mesh provider reused exact saved models from independently verified, matching source/native-input builds. Every ordinary per-piece and saved-build verifier ran. No new cold-meshing run is claimed for this integration. The wider fan had already been freshly compiled and reviewed before integration.
reproduction: Run the documented ordinary source build with the supported NAM profile. Private task cache helpers are optional and are not required to generate or verify these sources.
